title: Runner: warn when a module hotkey action blocks the keyboard hook

proposed_comments.body:
### Keep watchdog hotkey identities stable across keyboard layouts

**Severity:** `medium`

Please use the virtual-key descriptor for the watchdog's rate-limiter key. `ToWstring(shortcut)` obtains a display label from the current keyboard layout, while `ReportLimiter` stores that string as part of its `(module, hotkey)` identity. A layout-sensitive label can therefore create another limiter entry for the same registered virtual key and allow another report in the same session, contrary to the documented once-per-hotkey limit.

The existing `DescribeHotkey` helper derives the identity only from the registered modifiers and virtual-key code. Keep `ToWstring` for ordinary readable registration logs; only the watchdog key needs this change.

```suggestion
                    SlowHotkeyWatchdog::ReportSlowAction(
                        L"WM_HOTKEY",
                        moduleName,
                        SlowHotkeyWatchdog::DescribeHotkey(
                            (shortcut.modifiersMask & MOD_WIN) != 0,
                            (shortcut.modifiersMask & MOD_CONTROL) != 0,
                            (shortcut.modifiersMask & MOD_SHIFT) != 0,
                            (shortcut.modifiersMask & MOD_ALT) != 0,
                            shortcut.vkCode),
                        elapsed);
```

Please cover an OEM virtual key and confirm that the WM_HOTKEY and keyboard-hook descriptors share the same limiter identity.

confidence.rationale: The caller supplies a current-layout-derived string directly to the deduplication set; the existing numeric descriptor removes that dependency.

proposed_comments.title: Keep watchdog identities layout-independent

actions.label: Post inline suggestion for stable watchdog identities
